conflictRule: Higher-precedence sources shadow lower-precedence sources; only selected occurrences can become effective and therefore require profile eligibility and exact grants. Parseable superseded values remain audit-visible as shadowed; repeatable controls retain all selected granted values.

controls.meaning: Select the package registry origin for install, info, or publish.
controls.allowRule: Eligible profile plus an exact-origin grant; publish additionally requires write-plane authority.
controls.disallowRule: Deny ambient, credential-bearing, ambiguous, changed, or production registry overrides before process creation.

controls.meaning: Open a startup connection to an exact HTTP(S) origin before the runtime entrypoint.
controls.allowRule: Eligible online non-release profile plus an exact-origin grant.
controls.disallowRule: Deny offline, release, credentials, and ungranted origins before runtime launch.

controls.meaning: Load an exact reviewed module before the runtime entrypoint.
controls.allowRule: Development, test, CI, or canary plus an exact-value module grant.
controls.disallowRule: Deny production, offline, release, BUN_OPTIONS composition, and every ungranted module.

controls.meaning: Enable Bun's experimental HTTP/2 fetch client negotiation.
controls.allowRule: Development, test, CI, or canary plus an exact enabled grant.
controls.disallowRule: Deny production, offline, release, malformed environment values, and missing grants.

controls.meaning: Enable Bun's experimental HTTP/3 fetch upgrade behavior.
controls.allowRule: Canary only plus an exact enabled grant.
controls.disallowRule: Deny every non-canary profile, malformed environment value, and missing grant.

controls.meaning: Select an exact bunfig configuration source.
controls.allowRule: Controlled build profile plus an exact-value path grant.
controls.disallowRule: Deny production, offline, unknown paths, repeats, and missing grants.

controls.meaning: Load environment variables from an exact reviewed file before the entrypoint.
controls.allowRule: Development, test, CI, or canary plus an exact-value path grant.
controls.disallowRule: Deny production, offline, release, and ungranted environment sources.

controls.meaning: Change the runtime or package-manager working directory.
controls.allowRule: Controlled build profile plus an exact-value directory grant.
controls.disallowRule: Deny production, offline, unknown directories, repeats, and missing grants.

controls.meaning: Route an individual outbound request through an exact proxy origin.
controls.allowRule: Eligible online profile plus an exact-origin grant; only the sanitized value may be forwarded.
controls.disallowRule: Deny offline, release, credentials, ambient proxy injection, and missing grants.

controls.meaning: Route a request through an exact Unix-domain socket path.
controls.allowRule: Development or test plus an exact-value socket grant.
controls.disallowRule: Deny CI, canary, production, offline, release, and missing grants.

controls.meaning: Replace request TLS policy with a caller-provided object.
controls.allowRule: No grant can enable this control.
controls.disallowRule: Always deny custom TLS policy at the shared request boundary.

controls.meaning: Select a canonical h1, h2, or h3 request protocol override.
controls.allowRule: Eligible online profile plus an exact-value grant; h3 is canary-only.
controls.disallowRule: Deny offline, release, unrecognized aliases, h3 outside canary, and missing grants.

compositeDenials.meaning: Composite Bun runtime options that can hide multiple authority-bearing controls.
compositeDenials.allowRule: No non-empty value is accepted; callers must declare individual controls.
compositeDenials.disallowRule: Reject before launch without parsing or forwarding the composite string.

reservedAuthoritySpellings.meaning: No Bun 1.4 runtime or package-manager meaning; application-specific occurrences remain after the entrypoint.
reservedAuthoritySpellings.evidence: Pinned `bun --help` and `bun install --help` do not advertise this spelling.
reservedAuthoritySpellings.allowRule: Only an application CLI may own it after Bun's entrypoint or `--` boundary.
reservedAuthoritySpellings.disallowRule: Reject whenever it appears in the Bun authority segment.

reservedAuthoritySpellings.meaning: No Bun 1.4 runtime or package-manager meaning; repository matches belong to curl/wget output behavior.
reservedAuthoritySpellings.evidence: Pinned Bun help has no -O row; repository code has no Factory Bun-authority parser for it.
reservedAuthoritySpellings.allowRule: Only a non-Bun child tool may own it inside that tool's exact argv contract.
reservedAuthoritySpellings.disallowRule: Reject whenever it appears in the Bun authority segment.

reservedAuthoritySpellings.meaning: No Bun 1.4 runtime or package-manager meaning; search:smart owns -R as its runtime-list filter after the entrypoint.
reservedAuthoritySpellings.evidence: scripts/search-smart.ts parses -R and pinned Bun help has no -R row.
reservedAuthoritySpellings.allowRule: search:smart may parse it only as an application argument after the runtime entrypoint.
reservedAuthoritySpellings.disallowRule: Reject whenever it appears in the Bun authority segment.

applicationModes.meaning: Filter results to a comma-separated runtime list; this is not a Bun runtime override.
applicationModes.conflictRule: Application parsing begins after scripts/search-smart.ts; Bun authority parsing must not consume it.

applicationModes.meaning: Require the ETag verifier's live network suite instead of accepting offline-only proof.
applicationModes.conflictRule: Explicit --online/--probe wins over auto-detection and fails if the base is unreachable.

applicationModes.meaning: Force policy-only portal doctor behavior and suppress live Access probes.
Use the local tournament bake path and perform no remote tournament probe.
applicationModes.conflictRule: Offline wins for the tournament verification branch.

applicationModes.meaning: Require the offline partner-contract join rather than live partner data.
applicationModes.conflictRule: Explicit offline selects only the offline join; no live fallback is permitted.

applicationModes.meaning: Forbid fetching and require a saved HTML input.
applicationModes.conflictRule: Offline forbids RSS or HTML network fallback.

applicationModes.meaning: Select switchback or between-subject experimental design; this is not an HTTP protocol override.
applicationModes.conflictRule: The phase command owns this enum after its application entrypoint.

residualScopes: Complete reverse inventory of every application-local --offline/--online spelling outside package.json guarded entrypoints.
Direct guarded composition of request protocol/proxy controls into every outbound consumer.
Migration of all raw and dynamically assembled subprocess consumers to guarded Bun child authority.
